about_the_game:
Attention! Identical packs cannot be activated on one account twice!

Attention! Identical ships from different purchased bundles are not compensated!

This bundle includes:

This bundle includes special configuration of the Ellydium cover frigate “Drag'Thir” with a fully completed research tree and unlocked nodes.

Drag'Thir weapons: 

  • Ellydium cover frigate weapon: “Drag'Du” reactive weapon R13-17 Mk. 5 

  • Ellydium cover frigate weapon: “Drag'Gul” Alien weapon R13-17 Mk. 5 

Drag'Thir active modules:

  • Active module “Crystal prism” R13-17 Mk. 5 

  • Active module “Suppressing sphere”  R13-17 Mk. 5 

  • Active module “Gravipulsar”  R13-17 Mk. 5 

Drag'Thir modules and modifiers

  • CPU modifier “Radar jammer”

  • Hull modifier “Detonating crystals”

  • Shield modifier “Backup multifunctional shield”

  • Engine modifier “Teleportation sphere”

  • Capacitor modifier “Emergency capsule”

Additionally, the pilot receives:

  • 10% bonus to credits gain for 90 days

  • “Zale Ellestone” portrait

  • A set of colours: “Hastur’s hatred”, “Mysterious blue”, “Inferno”

  • “Rectangular stained glass” colouring

  • Unique animated decor “Plague doctor's mask”

  • “Observer effect” sticker

  • “Breaking bad and beyond” sticker

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 90 days!

An excerpt from a leaked internal UMC report:

“Long before the Yith'Mor project was finalized, Ellydium had begun developing a guard frigate. As early as 4620 and 4621, there were small leaks of information about the corporation's desire to develop a ship with a new role. The main difficulty in creating the ship later named “Drag'Thir” was that it was almost impossible to use standard Ellydium crystal nodes.

More complex elements were required. The needed parts were removed from living Crystallids only in 4624 for the first time. Information about the Ellydium’s study of these samples was passed on to the UMC and “The Frontier Voice” news agency by a source that remains unknown. Rumor has it that Natasha Cortés herself soon gave a good talking to the informant, making them realize the full extent of their mistakes.

Conrad Dimeni was able to convince the board of directors to use this as part of a promotional campaign for the new frigate. Shortly before the first “Drag'Thir” frigates rolled off the slipway, Ellydium issued a promotional publication about the creation of the new ship. One of the brochures, later withdrawn, indicated that the Leviathan power transfer technology was used in the creation of “Drag'Thir”. Some of the ship’s pilots noticed a suspicious similarity between some of the frigate’s elements and Liu Virus infected ships, but the Ellydium explicitly denied these rumors.

The ship has performed admirably in combat. We will soon be expanding the procurement of “Drag'Thir” for our mercenaries. Nevertheless, there is a proposal to investigate the reasons for the disappearance of “The Frontier Voice” journalist at Pilgrim-11 and the possible involvement of the Ellydium corporation. We need to find out if the unregistered capabilities previously observed in “Waz'Got” are present in this ship as well.”

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz, Intel Core 2 Duo / 2.5 GHz, AMD A6-9220
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Video Card: 512 MB, NVidia / AMD Radeon / Intel (HD 3000, HD 4000) with support for Pixel Shader 3.0 (AMD Radeon X1000 not supported)
  • Hard Disk Space: 8.5 GB
  • Additional: Broadband Internet connection

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz, Intel Core 2 Duo / 2.5 GHz, AMD A6-9220
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Video Card: 1024 MB, NVidia GeForce 650 / AMD Radeon HD 5750
  • Hard Disk Space: 8.5 GB
  • Additional: Broadband Internet connection
